insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Vi is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Vi in 44/115 games (38%): 9 picks (4-5) and 35 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Rumble? They go Ambessa
insights.text: Rumble is a G1 favorite (13/45 G1s, played by Kingen). In the 58 later games where it was burned or banned, Kingen went to Ambessa (9/58) and Camille (6/58).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they stay closer to their core than most
insights.text: In 26 G3+ games, 33/130 picks (25%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 63 champs in G1s, 72 in G3+.
